Concept candy owning the HARNESS gate hooks — the .claude/hooks/* git-discipline
scripts + their .claude/settings.json wiring, declared as `hook:` kind entities
(the plugins→candies migration). candy/plugin-marketplace (command:marketplace)
emits the scripts to .claude/hooks/ + regenerates the settings.json hook entries
from these entities, so the harness gates are generated from candy config.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | this documentation-only candy ships no install content (it carries the family's skill/hook/marketplace entities); validate-satisfying no-op |
| `check` | the harness gate hook entities carry the pre-commit/pre-push discipline content (byte-identical to the emitted .claude/hooks/* — proven by the marketplace plugin's generate test + the R10 bed) |
